summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) on October 8, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that President and CEO Cameron Chell will speak on a panel at the 2026 Raymond James Aerospace, Defense & Government Services Conference in Washington, D.C. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine investor-conference and publicity notice, not a special situation; watch only for potential capital-markets or strategic updates made alongside conference meetings.
